flags: GATE: $40 base, $48 holiday, Campspot + operator page, both under $50. RV type lists Motorhome. GS status: none stored and not stated. Nearest gateway: none within 40 km (Indiana Dunes NP 67 km). Family has not stayed. Presence: working site + Campspot; phone 574-542-4780 on Google; the site also gives text/call 574-225-2074. Google 4.6 from 345 reviews.

REVIEWS: mostly warm ('Amazing place to stay! Especially with kids', 3 months ago). One so-so, 3 months ago: 'Reservation instructions tell us to go check in at the camp store/office, which was closed ... Trash in the primitive sites from previous guests in the fire pit and along the edge of the river.' Those read as primitive-site complaints.

LONG-STAY: test 2 passes (posted rate + engine). Test 4 passes on a rough estimate only: Campspot sells 23 RV + about 20 primitive nightly, against seasonal sites 'Start at $1,700 per season, plus electric'. Undated winter imagery shows about 130 units left in place (about 50 stored in rows beside the pool, about 40 on the north row, about 40 on the east loop), so nightly is about 43 of about 170, roughly 1 in 4. The operator states no total.

WATER: stored 'riverfront' is a re-audit lead against the entry's own note (RV sites set back, river view at best). I could not plot F12-F38: Campspot's map would not render for a past date and 2027 isn't loaded. Imagery at about 1 m/px (scale estimated, canopy hides the bank): the east loop's outer units are about 30-60 m from the river through trees, the north row is about 50 m from an oxbow rather than the channel, the storage rows about 200 m. Operator: 'primitive camping along the serene riverbanks'. Nothing I read puts an RV site on the water, and nothing rules out the east loop's outer sites.
PIN: stored 41.16400,-86.55784 is Campspot's point at the office; RV areas start about 110-135 m away and run about 300 m. Left; can't locate the nightly sites more closely.
2027: Campspot shows closed through April 30, 2027 and returns nothing yet for May-July 2027, so no 2027 price exists. 2026 prices came from past dates the API still answers.
